label: Stage 1 -- K x EM-seed masker fits, beta=0.5, 8px 4-phase, 120 train tiles
reading: Fitting with k=2 reaches the same foreground direction as fitting with k=16: cross agreement cos(C_bar) = 0.9942 sits ABOVE the within-k=16 between-seed floor [0.9915, 0.9922]. The k=2-vs-k=16 difference is smaller than the difference between two random seeds of k=16, so over-provisioning is decoration, not scaffolding: it changes neither where the fit lands nor the rank of the solution.

em_init_variance.note: First measurement of masker-init variance in this project. The published +/-0.005 band is DETECTOR variance only -- the masker is fit once at seed 0 and shared across detector seeds. Direction agreement is high, so masker init is stable; this bounds direction, not AP.

pruning: Pruning fires RARELY and seed-dependently: k=16 seed 1 pruned to K_eff=15; seeds 0 and 2 did not prune. Earlier phrasing 'pruning never fires' was based on the deployed model and the two archived fit logs, which happened to be non-pruning runs. The conclusion is unchanged -- pruning removes at most one prototype and never approaches the effective rank (~1.3-2.0), because it tests starvation, not redundancy.
sanity_gate: k=16 seed 0 refit reproduces the deployed em_model_4p_fix.npz: effective rank 1.6562 vs 1.66, pairwise cosine 0.9935 vs 0.9935. The fit recipe reproduces the shipped model.
